# Transactional

`admin.offering.transactional` · offering_family · parent `—`

> High-volume, rule-bound processing where the same thing is done many times and correctness is defined by the rule rather than by the requester. Value is delivered at the moment the transaction completes and almost nothing is owed afterwards.


## Characteristics

|  |  |
|---|---|
| delivery | the completed transaction, immediately on processing |
| pricing_shape | cost per transaction |
| margin_profile | improves with volume; dominated by rework rate |
| post_sale_load | low — the record is the only residue |
| notes | Consumers: employees, suppliers and finance. Funded by chargeback per transaction or allocated overhead. An internal function with no chargeback has no natural brake on demand, which changes which capabilities matter and is why this line is recorded.  |
